say.speaker: boss
say.text: Heh, three village kids and a lost little bug, no grown-ups in sight! Fan out and corner them by the spring!

say.speaker: partner
say.text: Keep dreaming! Watch those spring pools, {lord}! I can splash straight across the shallow water while those thugs get stuck on the banks!

say.speaker: healer
say.text: And those thick trees beside us make great cover against their swings! Let's drive these thugs away together!

say.speaker: combee
say.text: That Zigzagoon up north is clutching an Oran Berry. One Bug Bite and it's our breakfast!
